entities.name: Abd al-Aziz Ibn Baz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abdulaziz ibn Abdullah Al Baz, known as Ibn Baz or Bin Baz, was a Saudi Islamic scholar who served as the second Grand Mufti of Saudi Arabia from 1993 until his death in 1999.
